text: natthiputtasamasuttaṃ [28] ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi natthi puttasamaṃ pemaṃ natthi gosamikaṃ dhanaṃ natthi suriyasamā ābhā samuddaparamā sarāti .
